title: Discover a compatible game-production toolchain
description: A reversible, evidence-producing workflow for discover a compatible game-production toolchain.

ordered_stages.action: Read project, OS, engine, DCC, GPU, and existing MCP metadata without mutation.
Filter candidates by license, platform, hardware, application, and security constraints.
Compare compatible candidates by capability, quality, cost, performance, and limitations.
Produce one digest-bound transaction with exact pins, permissions, backups, and rollback.
Wait for explicit human confirmation before any installation or configuration change.

quality_gates.description: Verify rights, consent, code, weights, datasets, output terms, and generation provenance.
Validate formats and domain-specific technical constraints.
Check visual identity and temporal consistency across relevant views and frames.
Check memory, frame time, draw calls, load time, and asset budgets.
Run interaction and playability smoke tests in the target runtime.
Store screenshots, artifacts, logs, versions, and comparison evidence.
Require human approval before replacing any source or production asset.
No unresolved license may be presented as commercially cleared.
Only one MCP server per host application may be active.

fallbacks: Use the checked-in offline catalog when GitHub metadata is unavailable.
Offer a verified native or hosted alternative when hardware is incompatible.
